verdict.rationale: Stable documents in-product AI-generated summaries of mail contents. The summary is listed as a plan feature and exposed as a `summary` field on scanned mail items, and Stable also describes an AI-powered inbox that auto-sorts and routes mail. This counts as AI-generated insight from the user's data, but it is limited to per-document summaries and routing; there is no evidence of broader insights or proactive suggestions. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, cross-mail or aggregate insights beyond per-document summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Summarize: Get AI-document summaries on the contents of your mail.
Your AI-powered inbox automatically sorts and routes your mail saving time and reducing errors.
